title: State packet
description: One 10 Hz snapshot of the match, computed deterministically from the event feed and the ball track. This is the fast path: the listener's device turns it into sound. Position is in the global frame (x 0..105 m, y 0..68 m, HOME attacks towards x=105); danger, pressure, tempo and control are 0..1; pan is -1 (attacker's left flank) .. +1 (right flank).

t.description: Match clock in seconds since kickoff.

team.description: Team in possession (or about to restart).

danger.description: Expected Threat at the ball in the attacking frame, scaled so the 99th percentile of a match is about 1. 0 when the ball is dead.

pressure.description: Exponentially weighted rate of pressure events against the team in possession (half-life 4 s).

tempo.description: On-ball actions in the last 60 s relative to the calibrated match average; 0.5 is average.

control.description: HOME share of in-play time over the last 5 minutes.
